[Step 2] Termination condition zeta (fixed/random n-gram, parsing, perplexity) segments the generated response into macro action boundaries {omega_tau} via get_macro_action_positions (boundary computation). [Step 3] Joint probability pi_theta(omega_tau | s_tau) = prod pi_theta(a_t | a_<t) is computed over each boundary segment (joint probability over segment). claims.claim: MA-PPO Algorithm 1 per-iteration execution order (Appendix E, Algorithm 1): Single-batch execution sequence repeated within Phase 3 PPO training (text/code pipelines), iterating over the Phase 3 data split until all training data is consumed. Upstream inputs per iteration: (a) prompt batch drawn from Phase 3 training data (40% split for text tasks or 80% split for code tasks); (b) current policy model pi_theta and reference model pi_ref (= Phase 1 SFT model); (c) critic model (initialized from RM checkpoint per model initialization scheme, or SFT checkpoint for code); (d) RM model r_phi (or piecewise compiler reward for code tasks); (e) termination rule zeta selected from the termination strategy step. Nine-step execution per batch: [S1] Generate responses y = pi_theta(x) for each prompt via rollout (1 sample per prompt). [S2] Compute per-token critic values V(s_t) = pi_critic(x, s_t) for every time step t in [0, |y|). [S3] Score each response r = pi_RM(x, y), then apply KL penalty to obtain reshaped per-token rewards (KL-penalized reward formula); for code tasks, use piecewise compiler reward formula instead. [S4] Compute macro action boundaries {omega_tau} = zeta(y) via get_macro_action_positions (boundary computation). [S5] Aggregate token-level values and rewards into macro-level tensors per segment via get_macro_action_values (macro value aggregation via mean). [S6] Apply standard GAE unchanged (lambda=0.95, gamma=1) on the reduced-dimension macro-level sequences to produce macro advantages A_hat_tau and returns (GAE at macro level). [S7] Compute MA-PPO policy loss L^{MA-PPO} from macro advantages and segment-level joint probability ratios via policy_loss_macro_action (MA-PPO clipped surrogate loss). [S8] Compute critic loss L^{value} from predicted macro values vs. target macro returns via critic_loss_macro_action. [S9] Gradient-descent update both policy and critic model parameters (PPO epochs=1, clip_ratio=0.2 per hyperparameter config). Downstream to Phase 4: the updated policy and critic models become the old_policy and old_critic for the next batch (return to S1); after exhausting all PPO training data, the final checkpoint proceeds to Phase 4 evaluation per the text evaluation protocol (RM scores on 2k validation instances, GPT-4 pairwise win rates on 50 instances, human win rates with 3 annotators) or the code evaluation protocol (pass@1 and pass@5 on 5k APPS test set).
